name: CAP cadet officer service cap insignia
size_basis: Vanguard product page "Civil Air Patrol Cap Device: Cadet Officer Service" prints 2 1/4 in high x 1 3/4 in wide (the regulation gives no dimension); the figure measures 323 x 401 px, a 0.805 aspect against the printed 0.778, so the figure measurements are scaled 3.5 % tighter in x than in y to land on the printed size
provenance: CAPR 39-1 3 Mar 2020 Fig A5-8 (p.138, CAP DEVICES row and the devices as drawn on the caps; A5-9 shows the same devices on the women's caps); every position measured on the 10x render (crop frame (96,85)): fan disc r 112 about (168,121) with 16 feather rows 13.2 px apart, six stars (corners y 39, row y 63-69, one at y 89), head r 15.5 at (168,134), shield x 110..226 y 232..345, wreath stem points along the leaf ribbon (10 leaf pairs a side, branches meeting under the shield at y 392); left half measured, right half mirrored

mounts.uniform: Men's / women's service cap, cadet officers
mounts.rule: centred on the front of the cap in device_slot_center; no clouds or darts (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)

documented: cadet officers wear the cadet service cap insignia; no clouds and darts for cadets (6.2.1.1.1, 6.2.1.2.1)
assumed: feather rows drawn as stepped pills, not the figure's relief
star count and positions read off a raster where each star is about 8 px (six read; low confidence)
eagle head, beak, breast rows and feet stylised: the figure shows only a 40 px head and a body mostly hidden by the fan
leaf shapes stylised along the measured wreath line; leaf count (10 pairs a side) estimated from the figure
two flat silver tones with a thin grey outline
